name: io.github.tonyyang0504/adform-mcp
description: Adform FLOW (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ADFORM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of an Adform API client enabled for the client-credentials flow (requested from Adform support; https://api.adform.com/help/guides/getting-started/authorization-guide).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ADFORM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The client's secret, sent in the form body of POST https://id.adform.com/sts/connect/token; the client must be granted the buyer.advertisers.readonly and buyer.campaigns.api.readonly scopes. Tokens last about an hour and are re-requested automatically.
